Daily Devotional

September 16

16 Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ (Galatians 3:16 KJV)

This is an amazing revelation by Paul, as the Jews had missed this truth for all those years, and they thought that this was speaking of themselves as the physical descendents of Abraham. The singular seed of Abraham that was being spoken of was Jesus, the seed of Abraham. The Jews could not believe that they were not the objects of all the promises made to Abraham, but only if they are in Christ.

Since we, as born again believers, are now part of the body of Christ (Romans 12:5), we therefore are part of that spoken seed of Abraham. Therefore we are the beneficiaries of the promises made to Abraham, and we are the true Jews (Romans 2:29), not by blood, but by faith in Jesus as our Savior. This was so radical in Paul’s day that the Jews were persecuting him everywhere he went. If you study the Old Testament and all the promises that God has made to Abraham’s seed, then you can just apply all those to yourself, if you are a Christian. Wow, that is wonderful, and thank you Jesus for bringing us into this covenant of promises.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
